title: Photo Scan Throughput by Album
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:photo album_name=* scans_completed=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(scans_completed) as metric by _time album_name
| sort 0 _time album_name
description: Trends monthly scans completed by album for photo scanning.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether photo scanning are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `album_name` on `genealogy:photo` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly scans completed.
visualization: Line chart of monthly scans completed by album.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how scans completed changes month by month for each album so you can see whether photo scanning are heading the right way.
